none: PAS BUC-1B81A8: Copper alloy Roman coin
contea di ritrovamento: Milton Keynes (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN ARCA [DIVS] ; R/ SALVS REI[PVBLICAE]

A copper alloy nummus of Arcadius. Reece period: Period 20 [378-388] Obverse description: A diademed bust right. Obverse inscription: DN ARCA [DIVS]. Reverse description: Victory walking with club over shoulder dragging captive from the right. Chi-rho in field. Reverse inscription: SALVS REI[PVBLICAE]. Degree of wear: Very worn: fair. Fourth Century reverse type: SALVS REI PVBLICAE
